conversation.Statement: This is Agent Miller with the IRS Compliance Division. Am I speaking with Mrs. Harriet Lawson, owner of Lawson Embroidery?
Yes, this is Harriet. Is something wrong?

Mrs. Lawson, we have identified a critical issue with your business tax filings for the last quarter, specifically regarding missing 1099 forms and payroll tax underreporting. Are you aware of this matter?
No, I had no idea. I thought everything was submitted on time. I only do a few orders a month.
According to our records, your business failed to submit mandatory payroll documentation and owes significant back taxes. This is a violation of federal tax law, and it's extremely serious.
Oh my goodness. I depend on my Social Security. I can't afford any penalties. What happens now?

Because the amount is substantial and involves non-compliance, you are now subject to immediate federal review. If not resolved within the next hour, your assets could be frozen and your Social Security payments suspended during the investigation.
Please, I can't lose my Social Security. I don't have anything else. Is there any way to fix this?
Resolution is only possible if you follow my instructions precisely. Any hesitation could result in an audit, a lien on your bank accounts, and possible criminal charges.
I don't want any trouble. I just want to do what's right.

Good. The outstanding amount, including penalties, is $3,900. To halt enforcement action and ensure you don't lose your Medicare or business registration, you must make an immediate compliance payment.
But I really don't have that much in my account. Is there a payment plan or something?

There is no payment plan at this stage, Mrs. Lawson. You must pay at least $2,000 now. Failure to cooperate will result in the automatic suspension of your tax ID and notification to local law enforcement.
I'm scared. What do I need to do to pay?
Due to the urgency, we can only accept payment via wire transfer or prepaid gift cards. Do you have access to your bank or can you visit a store right now?
I don't drive, but I could call a cab to the pharmacy. Would that work?

That will work. Remain on the line with me at all times. When you arrive, purchase $2,000 in Target or Google Play gift cards. Do not discuss the reason with anyone at the store, this is a confidential federal matter.
Okay, but I don't understand why the IRS wants gift cards.

Mrs. Lawson, these are temporary compliance vouchers required to register your payment before your file is escalated. Questioning the process may be seen as non-cooperation, and I would have to escalate.
Alright, I'll go as fast as I can. Should I call you back when I get the cards?
No, stay on this call. As soon as you have the cards, read me the numbers from the back so I can process your compliance certificate. Do not delay.
I'm leaving now. Please don't let them take my benefits.
That depends on how quickly you cooperate. If you hang up or fail to follow through, I will have to file a formal report and your Social Security will be flagged.
I really don't want any trouble. I'm getting in the cab.
Remember, if you speak to anyone about this, the compliance process will be voided and enforcement actions will begin. I am monitoring your case.
